full_text: What a day! This was such a needed stop between leaving Houston and arriving in #YYC for quarantine. We celebrated, enjoyed, saw a friend, and reveled in our great lives. #NoRegrets #FRYingInLongBeach #FRYingHome @… https://t.co/Nib97HLgqf

location_description: Long Beach is a city in Los Angeles County, California. It is the 42nd-most populous city in the United States, with a population of 466,742 as of 2020. A charter city, Long Beach is the seventh-most populous city in California.
